title: cert.rs: build_chain re-encodes trust-anchor subjects on every iteration
description: build_chain() calls trust_anchors.iter().any(|a| a.tbs_certificate().subject().to_der()...) on each iteration of the MAX_DEPTH loop. This encodes every trust anchor's subject DN to DER bytes on every loop step. For a depth-N chain with M trust anchors, this is O(N*M) DER encodes. Pre-computing a HashSet<Vec<u8>> of trust anchor subject DERs before the loop would reduce this to O(N) lookups. Same optimization applies to validate_chain's bridge_cert call for anchors - those are done upfront which is good. The chain building step should pre-hash the anchor subjects.
